Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog: Added a Social tab with two new ways to be found: Public Listing lets you list your live show (name, image, Venue/Global address) so listeners can browse straight in with no room code needed, and the DJ List is a persistent directory of DJ profiles with avatar/banner, animated name effects, weekly availability, likes, and an optional Aetherphone # listeners can copy. Both support reporting abuse. Fixed several off-center icon buttons and an expired Discord invite link.
